0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-6, 10th in the East, 2 games back in the Southeast) host the Celtics (6-2, 3rd in the East) in Charlotte's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Charlotte has lost five straight and is 2-3 at home, while Boston is 5-0 at home and has won its last game. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness), and Jayson Tatum (rest) and Payton Pritchard (eye abrasion) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Hornets lost 1-2 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 113-102 defeat in Boston on April 7, 2026.
